attributes.name: Blessing of the Grey Master
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any check to acquire a boon.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1 die to your checks to acquire boons.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Norgorber trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
